statement: Original MP+Nunchuk with re-attach/F6 on and 0x40 copy off re-sends report mode and reads F6 and MP calibration, but child 0x40/16 repeatedly returns error 7. Decoded gyro changes and Nunchuk buttons respond while the correctly bound Nunchuk stick stays centered. Together with W9g copied-block on acceptance under identical imported resources, this isolates the copy requirement for decoded Original Nunchuk stick on this native Dolphin path; it does not show a gyro requirement or qualify Plus/Classic copy necessity.

applicability.revision: Original / virtual Wii Remote PID 0306; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. W9h controlled local virtual-host experiment, synthetic imported calibration and explicit binding/creation flags. Independent decoded oracle is separate from raw frames; no physical/radio/game/release/timing or whole-controller qualification. #258 gates generic-binding release use.
